nom: La Roche-Posay Pure 12% Vitamin C Serum for Wrinkle Reduction and Radiance

avis.titre: * La Roche-Posay Vitamin C12 Serum Color Changed
avis.texte: I recently purchased another bottle of the La Roche-Posay Vitamin C12 Serum from Ulta. It is the exact same product that I've been using. My previous bottle was a golden-orange color, but this new bottle is almost clear, like water. The liquid is much lighter than my previous bottle, even though it's the same product. I'm concerned because the color is very different from the one I've used before. Is this normal, or could there be an issue with this batch? Should I continue using it, or would you recommend exchanging it? Thank you!

avis.titre: Do not buy- it stings, pills!
avis.texte: Burnt my skin. Pills my makeup or the moisturizer, in case there is no make up. My skin is peeling like anything, I was assuming maybe it's doing good. But, it has burnt me skin and made my skin so dry. Had to read the other reviews to believe it. Was thinking "this is Vitamin C in-action".

avis.titre: I knew I should've returned this
avis.texte: I knew I should've returned this serum the first day I used it the smell was way too strong like perfumed self tanner and the scent lingers. I decided to give a real try despite the scent. It started of almost clear in color and now less than 2 months after opening it, it has oxidized to dark orange. I haven't noticed any difference in my skin from using this. I don't really want to finish it.

avis.titre: I do buy this product again and again.
avis.texte: keep your hair up and away as product can stain lighter color hair. Product does react with air and turns brown in the bottle over time. Only need to do this for a few minutes till it dries. I have sensitive skin and rosacea. Seems to help.
This probably works, however, it bleeds orange color through my sunscreen (tried several types). It also makes some of the sunscreens peel off. Too bad - I like this brand.

It smells like an ashtray. I gave it an hour but it still smells bad. Looked up other reviews, got freaked out by people turning orange or breaking out, so now I'm off to wash it off. No way would I purchase this
Not for sensitive skin. Burned so badly left my face comepletely red and painful.

avis.titre: Not the vitamin C product I was expecting
avis.texte: The salicylic acid and the smell after the product sits on my skin are both big turn offs for me on this product.

I used this for 3-4 months. A little goes a long way. I liked the fragrance, it smelled clean compared to the other stinky vitamin c serum I've used in the past. It also went on my skin SO smooth! I really loved how hydrating it was. It's NOT greasy, NOT sticky and made my skin feel SO smooth and matte. I can't say I noticed any difference with fine lines or dark spots, but maybe I needed to use it for longer. **My HUGE issue with this serum was that I started getting very prominent clogged pores/hard keratin plugs on my cheeks and on my jawline. I stopped using this serum almost 2 months ago and my skin is smooth again. All in all, I wanted to like this serum. But it wasn't for me.

I wanted to love this… it goes on easily, the smell doesnt bother me, and I felt like it made my skin feel pretty soft… but left terrible orange patches on my skin! The first day I wore it under my makeup, I felt like an oompa loompa because I ended up with an orange tint on my skin. So I tried to move it to nighttime instead, and ended up having to scrub it off in the morning. I am pretty fair skinned so not sure if thats why the orange tint is so obvious - but unfortunately I will be returning.

It made my skin sticky also looks like there was a sunless tanner used. Orange coloring on skin isn't attractive. I dialed it back to 1 drop but still didn't wok well. Also "dropper" doesn't work well.
I did not like this product in less the one month the texture and color change . The item not worth for the price

Pills makeup like crazy. I've waited 1,5, 30 min and an hour after application...it doesn't matter. Also, it doesn't play nice w/ La Roche moisturizer either. Whether you use this serum alone or w/ moisturizer, it pills.

I finished the bottle before giving the review cause I wanted this to be a fair rating. This product is overpriced for no reason. I cnt say it's done anything for my skin. In the beginning there was some serious pealing and I figured maybe it's a good thing and my skin is under construction lol but no I think it's just too strong for normal skin. Over priced for no reason. I would not recommend

I use other posay products so i wanted yo try this. It stuck so bad i had to return it. It smells like a bad self tanner from the 90's. I could not even get the smell off my hands by washing them 2-3 times. Maybe it was rancid? I just know i could not stand the smell. It was very sticky on my face as well after using. I had trouble getting it out of the dropper too. I had to pour it out into my hand. I exchanged for Dermalogica vit c serum and it almost has no smell and is not sticky. Maybe my bottle was just old, but I'd smell yours before buying.

avis.titre: I not sure I will purchase this again
avis.texte: I have not had it long enough to give a knowledgeable review. However, for the length of time I have had it it is diminishing dark areas. I see a difference in my skin tone. I do not like that it is sticky to touch.

I love this brand because it has never caused me to breakout or get a rash. I have sensistive acne prone skin and this is the only vitamin C i will use. I just wish the price relfected the prices of their other products.

avis.titre: Don't use if you have hyperpigmentation👎
avis.texte: This cling so horribly to my hyperpigmentation. It made my dark patches around my mouth stain orange- it was embarrasing. I stopped using this & have not had issues since.

avis.titre: Brightens after just a couple days
avis.texte: Initially got this during a sale and was pleasantly surprised at how much I enjoy this serum! It almost has a calming feeling during application and instantly smooths and brightens my skin. The scent is something I enjoy - but if your nose is extremely sensitive I would not recommend. Like a few other reviews have mentioned, this serum does indeed leave an orange layer on your skin. I don't think it is noticeable at all and only found out while blowing my nose and seeing the orange on the tissue, lol. Most days I only do skincare, but I do occasionally wear a full beat face and haven't had any issues with layering makeup on top. :)

I purchased this product online, but they sent me one that had already been opened, used, and oxidized. This is unacceptable and intolerable. When a product is paid for, they will be happy, but we receive trash. When we receive something subpar, we feel as though we can't even voice our concerns. It's very frustrating.

avis.titre: bad application, piles and peels with make up
avis.texte: Just horrible, my makeup piles and peels even leaving on for up too 10 mins to absorb, the dropper never worked so disappointing

avis.titre: Stained clothes and interfere with tinted sunscreen
avis.texte: All my tinted sunscreen became yellow with this serum. Also, it stains the clothes. I dont like the fragrance as well. I have rosacea, but the serum did not cause any irritation

avis.titre: Good for my oily and overexposed skin
avis.texte: I've been using this product for over a month now and I have no complaints. It hasn't aggrevated my skin and feels nice to use.
Am I the only one that this turns orange when my skin watms up?
I've been trying different vitamin c serums and ive never really liked any of them so I gave this a try thinking it would just be like the rest but omg i got results in just one week of use!!

This is the best vitamin c serum out there in my opinion. When I first used it I cleansed my face with the cetaphil gentle cleansing gel and used the cetaphil vitamin c eye cream. I used a light amount of the serum and warmed it between my fingers and spread it over my face. It felt wonderful, just soaked right in and gave me an immediate glow. The scent was nice not overwhelming just light. I waited a few minutes and followed up with the La roche posay moisturizer with sunscreen. My skin looked and felt wonderful all day. I highly recommend it if you're looking for a true lightweight vitamin c serum.

My dermatologist recommended this product and I love it. I have very sensitive skin and son't like trying new different products but this is Amazing I. started seeing results within the first few days. I use it together with the HA.
This product is great quality. The smell is stronger than other Vitamin C serums I have used but it's still a pleasant scent. This product is a must for my skin care routine.

I concur with other reviews that the product throughout the day turns orange. I would catch myself in the mirror with orange film around the top of my hairline and along the sides of my face. I didn't mind the scent or viscosity but I will be returning this. For the price, it was very disappointing.
Leaves you looking orange, when you sweat you can see some of the discoloration of the product on your face

This product dies have a pretty hefty price for such a little bottle. But dont let that fool you, becasue i got mine vitamin c serum at christmas time. And it lasted me all the way up to July. Its August now and i would say if you want a quality product get this one. I lvoe the tinted orange color, because it makes me look more tan, and suprisingly it smells really good. %100 recommend this product worth the cost

avis.titre: Leaves an orange film on your face
avis.texte: I initially liked this serum, it's got a nice scent and texture. It absorbed relatively easily. But one day my husband looked at me and asked what I had on my face... it was a dark orange/brownish build-up that pilled off when I rubbed it. This kept happening. I was experimenting to see if it was due to a certain combo of products or makeup - but it seemed to happen in different scenarios. I stopped using. Not worth the paranoia when I go out in public.... If you are in the market for a new Vitamin C, I'd skip this one and find a different option.

They need to make the squeeze syringe applicator MUCH skinnier because when the bottle is full and the product is coating the outside of the syringe tube, you can't get it back in the bottle without wasting a ton of product down the sides!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] My new favorite vitamin C! I am a skin care junkie, and usually have sensitivity to vitamin C serums. This has been gentle, but effective, and I have noticed improvement with my discoloration in just over a week! The scent and texture are delightful too!
Left my skin glowy and a little sticky, which is a pro or con! Havent noticed a change in my skin but will continue to monitor it! Easy application!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love La Roche Posay products and this one was really good. It's a good vitamin c for the face and neck. The ingredients are good and it leaves your skin radiant, moisturized and it absorbs quickly. After using for weeks you see a difference in radiance, your skin will look brighter and more even toned. I've seen a small change in my fine lines and some small dark spots so I know it's working. It is lightweight and doesn't leave a sticky feeling. It has a faint scent that isn't overpowering. It doesn't sting even if your skin is irritated which is great. I love the packaging, it's a dropper bottle so easy to use and love that it's glass. It is definitely one of my favorites I've used drug store. I will definitely recommend and continue to use.

if you are brave enough to purchase this product, make sure to test it at home and do not blindly use it before going to work or an important event. it oxidized on my face and gave me orange blotchy patches, looked like I had a skin disease. I was out in the puy and embarrassed, could not wait to go home to wash it off...

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love la roche-posay, really good product very fluid, no bad small, the texture is nice and the packaging is so high quality, I'm look forward to see how gonna be on my skin
I would say that the oil is good and it doesn't have a bad scent. I like the packaging as the dropper isn't already in the bottle! Makes it feel more durable

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It goes on oily but dries pretty quickly. No strong scent. I think it's effective, my skin already feels softer after only a couple of days. Wrinkles are less noticeable.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It goes on oily but dries pretty quickly. No strong scent. I think it's effective, my skin already feels softer after only a couple of days. Wrinkles are less noticeable.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love love love this serum!! I could tell a difference immediately! It's goes on smoothly and isn't sticky. It helps to minimize pores and gives your skin a glow.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] After using it for a while, I noticed that the acne scars on my face have faded a lot. My skin looks brighter, more even, and even in the summer, it doesn't get as oily as before. I'm really happy with the results so far

[I received this product in exchange for review.It has a fresh scent. Doesn't feel oily on the skin. I just started this product so I'm not sure on the long term effects yet. It's supposed to make your skin less oily after one month. I hope it works because I have a lot of oil around my nose.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really love this. It has a nice texture and I feel like it's very brightening. The packaging is nice and it's super effective. The ingredients are always top-tier.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I have used this for a couple of weeks and not seen much change. It makes your skin soft at first but after a while it felt oily. Has a slight order but nothing offensive. Not for me.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I'm in love with this serum! I've been using it for a while and I really like how my skin looks. It is perfect for balancing skin oiliness , provides great hydration, improves texture and adds more radiance.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] La Roche-Posay Vitamin C12 Oil Control Serum is my newest product added to my skincare routine. I usually apply it at bedtime before the mosuurizeer. The serum is refreshing and my poors look smaller. My skin is a bit sticky after this serum but my moisturizer eliminates the issue. My face is hydrated but not oily.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review La Roche-Posay Vitamin C12 Oil Control Serum is my newest product added to my skincare routine. I usually apply it at bedtime before the mosuurizeer. The serum is refreshing and my poors look smaller. My skin is a bit sticky after this serum but my moisturizer eliminates the issue. My face is hydrated but not oily.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love this La Roche-Posay Vitamin C 12 Oil Control Serum. It goes on nice and sleek and smells amazing ! It leaves your skin so radiant and soft and is a good staple for reducing the signs of wrinkles.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really enjoy the feel of this oil serum. It has a nice consistency as well as applies to the skin very well. I've seen some change in my skin since using this. My only concern is is not in a dark bottle.

avis.titre: I would not buy this product
avis.texte: This turns my face orange, with or without my tinted moisturizer. Changes the color of my complexion, so I would not buy again. I want to return it.

avis.titre: Good vitamin C but terrible dropper and bottle
avis.texte: This is a good vitamin C with the added benefit of salicylic acid. That said, the dropper is terrible. It takes a few tries to get the product in the dropper. The product gets all over the bottle when you put the dropper back in the bottle. Plus, the bottle isn't opaque so it oxidizes fast. For the price point, I would expect better. Docked a star for that.
started getting compliments on my skin when I started using this. Will repurchase
Turned my face and neck completely orange. was at work and was so embarrassed and had to scrub it all off and no I did not use anything else, it was from this and I got it recently.
It used to be called vitamin C serum but now it's vitamin C 12 serum if I'm correct. I believe it's the same product.
It used to be called vitamin C serum but now it's vitamin C 12 serum if I'm correct. I believe it's the same product.

This is my 3rd bottle. This product does what it says it does and it doesn't irritate my very sensitive skin. It makes my complexion look brighter and even toned. It has a very light pleasant scent that goes away after a few seconds.

avis.titre: Smells terrible. Turned hands and face orange.
avis.texte: I read the reviews regarding the smell and I thought how bad could it be? Well its terrible. Rusty and rotton egg smell. Product turned my hands and face orange and I only used it once a day. I'm returning this product.

I wanted to love this product… I have had great experiences with others in this brand line. I needed a new vitamin C serum but this one was too strong for me. The salicylic acid was clearly too much for my skin, I was breaking out more than I ever do. Bummer since I still had more than half bottle and the price wasn't cheap.
I absolutely love this serum. It makes my face feel so smooth and refreshed.

This product actually delivers what it says it does. So many other products out there promise all these benefits, but they don't deliver results. I have really sensitive skin and this does not irritate my skin at all. My skin looks more even toned, hydrated and brighter. It has a very pleasant scent also.

I have noticed that my skin is better since I started to use it. My skin feels soft and clear.I highly recommed this Vitamin C serum. I use everyday in the morning and then I use my sunscreen, and it has worked perfect.
Feels pretty thick and has a pleasant enough fragrance. Feels like it takes a bit to dry and when I put on BB cream etc. it pills on my skin. So not sure if I'm using too much?

Really wanted to love this product like all the others from this company. But not even 3 hours after applying it to my face I broke out in my t zone and across my cheeks. Stopped using it that day. Those areas felt burnt and were red for a week.

I used this product daily for about 3 months. The first two months it didn't do much so I thought I needed to use it for longer. But then I noticed that it was giving me a melasma mustache and only worsened when I went on vacation and was out in the sun. I stopped using this product immediately and now months later I still have very dark skin on my upper lip. I'm hoping Musely will work to get rid of the hyperpigmentation because it's really embarrassing.

I love this vitamin c product. This is my third time purchasing as this is the only vitamin c product I use. This is recommended for acne skin and people who have pimples or acne prone. I love the smell and feels refreshing and helps my pimples a lot.
Bad package oxidized the product and made it react and darken my pores.

avis.titre: Dermatologist Recommended it and I am not disappointed
avis.texte: This stuff is pretty amazing. I dont say that lightly. I noticed my skin looked brighter and healthier after one application. My dermatologist says you must wear sunscreen over which I have been. The applicator is terrible and does make a mess. But the product itself is great so Ill deal with it.
I been using it for a week so far. I have very sensitive skin and my skin looks fine not breaking out or anything. I only use it a night though then I wash my face with cold water in the morning.
Vitiman C needs to be stored better - the bottle does not do it, caused breakouts

I really wanted to love this product, but it pilled TERRIBLY and the fragrance was way too strong for me. I thought the droppler was awkward and messy, and the consistency of the serum was too thick. Don't waste your money on this one….
Laroche knows Vitamin C needs to be stored in a light proof airtught container. Do not waste your money on this. Will be ineffective in no time.

avis.titre: Vitamin C Serum  turned bad in less than 3 months
avis.texte: Half way using the bottle the product turned thicker and the color change to deep orange color almost red developing an unpleasant smell. Since you only need a small amount of product for your daily application buying this large bottle is a waste of money because after only two months of use the product start changing and the consistency and possibly the effects are no longer positive. Fortunately Ulta allowed me to return it. I wonder if someone else experienced the same problem with the Vitamin C Serum. I loved other of the products from this brand though.
I have views the 7 for the past 2 weeks and can tell a brightness in my skin complexion. I'm really enjoying this product.

avis.titre: I like the product but hate how Ulta ships it
avis.texte: I like the product, Ulta does a poor job at packaging face products. When shipped the box is usually damaged because it's being just thrown into a shipping box without taking cautious considerations of the item. Bag it and seal it.

I started using this on advice if my dermatologist but only at night. She said vit c deteriorates in daylight. So I use another product in day. I see skin tone improvement on upper lip where I apply. I gave 4 stars because i dont like bottle. It makes for sloppy pulling dropper in and out. Product gets caught on bottle lip, builds up and turns brown. This product is not cheap so its a waste of money. I complained to manufacturer. My day product by same company has a ring in the bottle mouth that gently scrapes dropper sides as you pull out. This one should be the same.
This is the worst Vitamin C I've ever used. Its super sticky, doesn't absorb into skin, and makes your skin turn orange byt the end of the day. Absolutely terrible.

avis.titre: This has been a game changer!
avis.texte: I have used this serum for about a year and it has made a huge difference in my "turkey neck." I'm 60 years old and I was struggling with my neck - I hated it! It didn't take long after starting this product when I realized it was helping - SO MUCH!
Sticky and messy. Had no negative effects on my skin but no positive ones either. I used morning and night till the bottle ran out and saw no change at all.
My skin start showing melasma but very mild then i used vit c and rentiol of lo roche posay it make worst
This product was to runny and water down. I would rather pay a little more and get a good vitamin C like from Skin Ceutical.

avis.titre: I have been using this product for years
avis.texte: It's helped my face so much with dark marks please try and see for yourself

This is my second bottle, and I can tell the formula improved since the first time. I vouge for this brand, but the first bottle did leave a slightly orange residue. I promise you if you didnt like their old formula, you would be pleasantly surprised with this one
I've purchased this product several times, but it consistently turns gooey and doesn't work well with other products like face cream or serums.

I could not provide a fair review to how this product actually works as far as transforming the skin because the applicator is so awful. I never write reviews or care about these types of things but the applicator barley picks up any product and then cannot hold on to the product. It also gets all over the mouth of the bottle when you take the applicator in and out of the bottle, so a bunch of product gets wasted. My derm recommended this to me but I will be looking for a different vitamin C because this is not worth the trouble.

Has a STRONG baby wipe smell, i couldn't believe how strong it smelt. Product oxidizes quickly, and it has messy packaging that spills. I'm usually not that sensitive, but this broke me out soooo bad.

I used this everyday until I completely finished the full size bottle and didnt really notice a difference. It applies well and didn't irritate my skin but for almost $50 its not worth it since I didnt see any results.
I have clear combination skin type and this tingled and gave me acne. Great for acne prone skin type but if you have clear skin you will break out.

I really loved this serum at first, and felt like it was making a difference with my skin but it oxidizes way to quickly. It starts as the color in the Ulta ad pictures and then quickly, like within a month changes to orange. I put the lid on and tighten right after i drop it on my hand and keep it away from the sun but it doesn't matter. I've bought it twice, thinking maybe the first one was a bad batch but its done it both times. Really disappointing because I really liked it, but just not worth it if you can only use half a bottle of it.

avis.titre: of course I'm buying this lovely item again!
avis.texte: It has been an incredible experience to feel this serum glide on each morning!

avis.titre: I love this serum, not the bottle
avis.texte: I love this serum! I have combination skin and I haven't experienced any breakouts or irritation. I noticed my skin tone is more even and it somewhat smoothed my fine lines. My pores are still there but a little less noticeable. As someone already mentioned, the dropper makes a mess when you're putting it back in the bottle, and you end up wasting a lot of product.

avis.titre: Love it - just not the added scent
avis.texte: Love it! Feels so silky and my skin has been clear and vibrant! Just don't like that they added fragrance to it. Don't want unnecessary ingredients on my skin.
The smell is overpowering. It irritates my eyes and the applicator gets super messy and it spills. Overpriced for what it is. Only good thing is it leaves a smooth finish.

I love this serum, very hydrating. I just wish they did a better job on the dropper tho. It honestly creates a mess. When you put the dropper back in the bottle, lots and lots of products that's on the dropper gets wasted around the head of the bottle, I hope that makes sense. But it's almost like I need to make sure there's no product on the whole dropper so that it diesnt get wasted when i put it bavk in. Also, i felt that it doesnt really mix in well with sunscreens and also makeup. It also can cause flakes. I lovd the hydration and the way it feels on my skin. I just wish there was more product, the dropped wastes the product too and thats one other reason why i hate the dropper as well
Very good quality product I loved Very hydrated skin and glow it.

For instance, I have oily, acne prone skin. This serum oxidezed and broke me out in places that never had breakouts before. I quit using for a bit to test if it was the serum and it was. This serum also had fragrance so thats another major downside
This stuff is amazing! My skin looks clear and healthy. I love it!
I adored the 10% Pure Vitamin C Serum, but I wish the fragrance had been eliminated.
i never leave reviews but this does wonders. especially seeing your skin the morning after < 3
Horrible product - could not use as it leaves a yellow stain on my face and neck.

avis.titre: Cheap feeling and no value added
avis.texte: saw zero difference or improvement on my skin using this product
Seems to be working, my skin is starting to look & feel smoother.

I haven't tried this product long enough, but I've been using it for 3 days and I feel the difference. A bit of context about my skin: acne-prone, combination, and sensitive. I've been battling adult acne for years, and although there are times when it improves, other times it worsens. I've been through 3 dermatologists with different treatments, and no matter how well they work for a while, the acne always comes back. My hormones and other lab results are fine, but the acne always returns. I decided to add this product to my routine since I love La Roche Posay products, and my skin looks more glowy, and the spots/breakouts I had are diminishing. I feel like what my skin was lacking was hydration, and I feel like this product is delivering. I'll leave my comments on how it continues later.
Amazing product, I won't stop using it, my skin loves this vitamin c.
I used before but it's purchased overseas . Doesn't sounds is the same components .

avis.titre: Nice Serum - I Mix It In With My Moisturizer
avis.texte: I've tried the Le Roshe Posay Vitamin C 10% serum on it's own and even though I do like the product very much I felt it didn't completely absorb into my skin which resulted in some pilling. I'm in my 60s so it's possible I need a more emollient vitamin C product. I tried mixing a few drops in to my moisturizer (I use RoC Multi Correxion Chest, Neck and Face Cream SPF 30) and it worked beautifully (the moisturizer doesn't contain Vit C so it works.) I'll use it up this way which is fine with me and it works very nicely! I probably won't buy the product again since it doesn't adsorb as it should in my skin, but I think on other skin types it would be excellent and I would recommend it.

when I applied the serum for the first time ever I immediately knew the product was going to be amazing. The smell, the consistency when using with the moisturizer it became a combination of a wonderful product. This is by far the best I've had on my face. I stop using other products to continue on my journey with La Roche thank you.
This product oxidizes or something quickly so it leaves orange splots all over your face- I used it twice before I had to stop because I looked oompa loompa ish.

I've been using product a couple of months, I can really see difference in my skin tone and texture. I believe the customers complaining about pilling are using too much, my suggestion is to start with a few drops then see if you need more. I have sensitive skin and mild rosacea, I've had no problems with this product.
